text: Coach {name} stares at the wall. 'Ideally... we do not lose.'
Coach {name} slams the desk! 'WE ATTACK! NO MERCY! SWING HARD!'
Coach {name} checks the tablet. 'The data suggests a 12% shift in infield depth.'
Coach {name} grunts. 'Back in my day, we bunted with our teeth. Bunt more.'
Coach {name} gazes out the window. 'The ball is round. The game is long. Be like water.'
Coach {name} folds his arms. 'Less talk. More hard contact.'
Coach {name} paces the room. 'LEGS. FIRE. STEAL EVERYTHING NOT NAILED DOWN!'
Coach {name} whispers, 'Slow breath. Clean innings. Let the game come to us.'
Coach {name} smirks. 'We gamble early. Bunt? Maybe. Squeeze? Definitely. Or not. Keep them guessing.'
Coach {name} draws strange arrows. 'Third baseman bats leadoff. Catcher steals second. Trust me.'
Coach {name} aligns pens. 'No wasted pitches. No free bases. Execute the plan precisely.'
Coach {name} smiles. 'We'll tailor the plan to your swings. Play your game; we'll cover you.'
Coach {name} lowers his voice. 'They bite on feints. Show bunt, pull back, steal third.'
Coach {name} taps the lineup card. 'No let-up. Run counts to three, foul off everything, break them.'
Coach {name} grins wide. 'Crowd's with us. Feed them fireworks—loud barrels and bold steals.'
